metadata.question: Does the chlorophyll concentration in the Gulf of Mexico off southwestern Florida increase in November 21, 2004 compared to October 30, 2004?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Ocean Color data (MODIS Aqua or Terra) for chlorophyll-a concentration - Collection: "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI" or "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Terra/L3SMI" - Dates: October 30, 2004 and November 21, 2004 (specific dates) - Location: Gulf of Mexico off southwestern Florida (approximate area around 26°N, 82°W) 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data already has quality flags built in - Should apply cloud masking and use valid pixel flags - Focus on the 'chlor_a' band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If no images found for either date → C1 - If images exist but all pixels masked → C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - If valid values exist, compare October vs November - If November > October → A (Yes) - If November ≤ October → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Gulf of Mexico off southwestern Florida const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-83, 25], [-83, 27], [-81, 27], [-81, 25], [-83, 25]] ]); // 2. Data acquisition for both dates const oct30 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate('2004-10-30', '2004-10-31') .filterBounds(region) .select('chlor_a'); const nov21 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate('2004-11-21', '2004-11-22') .filterBounds(region) .select('chlor_a'); const octSize = oct30.size().getInfo(); const novSize = nov21.size().getInfo(); console.log(`October 30 images: ${octSize}`); console.log(`November 21 images: ${novSize}`); // Check if collections are empty if (octSize === 0 || novSize === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get images and calculate mean chlorophyll const octImg = oct30.first(); const novImg = nov21.first(); // Count valid pixels const octCount = octImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const novCount = novImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`October 30 valid pixels: ${octCount}`); console.log(`November 21 valid pixels: ${novCount}`); if (octCount === 0 || novCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean chlorophyll concentration const octMean = octImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const novMean = novImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`October 30 mean chlor_a: ${octMean}`); console.log(`November 21 mean chlor_a: ${novMean}`); // 5. Validation and final answer if (octMean === null || novMean === null || isNaN(octMean) || isNaN(novMean)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (octMean < 0 || novMean < 0 || octMean > 100 || novMean > 100) { console.log('Invalid chlorophyll range'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare values if (novMean > octMean) { console.log(`Increase: Nov (${novMean.toFixed(3)}) > Oct (${octMean.toFixed(3)})`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No increase: Nov (${novMean.toFixed(3)}) <= Oct (${octMean.toFixed(3)})`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
